question.title: Will the Milwaukee Brewers win the 2026 World Series?
question.description:
Major League Baseball's World Series is a best-of-seven championship between the National League (NL) and American League (AL) pennant winners; the first team to win four games wins the title. The Milwaukee Brewers won the 2026 NL pennant, sweeping the Los Angeles Dodgers 4-0 in the National League Championship Series to reach the World Series for the first time since 1982. The Brewers posted the best regular-season record in MLB (103-59). As of October 16, 2026, the AL champion is undecided: the Cleveland Guardians lead the Tampa Bay Rays 2-1 in the AL Championship Series.

The 2026 World Series is scheduled across October 23, 24, 26, 27, 28, 30, and 31, with the Brewers holding home-field advantage (Games 1, 2, 6, and 7 in Milwaukee). Entering the series, the Brewers were installed as betting favorites (roughly -170, about 63% implied). A best-of-seven series can last four, five, six, or seven games; Game 6 (October 30) and Game 7 (October 31) are played only if the series is not already decided.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves YES if the Milwaukee Brewers are the winning team of the 2026 World Series (Major League Baseball's championship series, a best-of-seven played between the Brewers and the American League champion, with Games 6 and 7, if needed, scheduled for October 30 and 31, 2026). It resolves NO if the American League champion (the Cleveland Guardians or Tampa Bay Rays) wins the 2026 World Series instead. Resolution is based on the official 2026 World Series result as reported at https://www.baseball-reference.com/postseason/2026_WS.shtml or, if unavailable, by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions).
question.fine_print: If the World Series is abandoned without a champion being crowned (so that no team is recorded as the 2026 World Series winner), the question is annulled.
